lead: Bappi Lahiri was an Indian composer, born on 27 November 1952 in Kolkata.
He died on 15 February 2022 in Mumbai at the age of 69.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Music Director and Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award.
The sections that follow break down Bappi Lahiri's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Bappi Lahiri — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bappi Lahiri was born on 27 November 1952 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Aparesh Lahiri and his mother, Banshari Lahiri.
He is recorded as speaking Bangla.
